summary: Raises a C++ exception of type std::logic_error. The __thiscall receiver is run through CObjectConstructorWithVtable to install its vtable, then CxxThrowException8 is invoked with a 28-byte stack buffer as the exception-object payload and the RTTI type_info descriptor for std::logic_error. The throw never returns normally; the trailing ExceptionDestructorSEHWrapper is the SEH unwinding teardown result.

local_names.v2: 28-byte stack buffer used as the thrown exception-object storage
local_names.this: __thiscall receiver whose vtable is initialised before the throw

operations.description: CObjectConstructorWithVtable(this) constructs the receiver and installs its vtable before the throw is raised.
CxxThrowException8(v2, &type_info for std::logic_error) raises a C++ exception of type std::logic_error using the 28-byte stack buffer v2 as the exception-object storage.
ExceptionDestructorSEHWrapper() is the throw helper's SEH teardown; the throw diverts control on unwind and does not return to the caller normally.

unresolved: No callers are recorded in the packet, so the failure context that raises this logic_error is unknown.
The internal layout of the 28-byte exception object (e.g. logic_error message storage) is not described.
Whether CObjectConstructorWithVtable constructs the logic_error itself or an unrelated wrapper object is unresolved.
